name: d ACCOUNT OpenID Connect Client
description: An OpenID Connect client plugin for 'd ACCOUNT connect' sign-on, built on the openid_connect module (which handles the OAuth state/CSRF, token exchange and user mapping). Store the client ID/secret as secrets; keep openid_connect updated.
project_description:
OpenID Connect client / plugin for d ACCOUNT 
 This module is a Business d ACCOUNT client for OpenID Connect .

 We are more focusing on Business d ACCOUNT rather than the generic d ACCOUNT for consumers. Business d ACCOUNT can be achieved by using the Generic client in OpenID Connect . The OpenID Connect d ACCOUNT clien t basically does the same thing, but adds some Business d ACCOUNT specific settings.
